subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The teacher connected the experiment to food security and biodiversity.”?
options: Old crops can carry traits that become valuable again under new conditions.
In geography class, students learned about seed vaults, places where seeds are stored for the future.
Old seeds may contain traits useful for future farming.
The old posters became useful classroom tools.
